- Liaise with technical team(s) -- when needed -- to resolve environment related issues and necessary enhancements in preparation for cloud deployment

- Analyze, formulate, proposed, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables

- Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

1. Provide professional services to Murex clients:

o Provide services in the domain of system integration, business intelligence and data flows through the full lifecycle of the MX.3: requirements analysis, configuration build, installation, training, upgrade, and production support.

o Professionally interact with Murex colleagues and clients.

2. Build, test, and provide support to clients on MX.3 integration modules.

o Contribute to project implementations

 Participate in design, build, and test phases sometimes remotely and other times at the client site as needed.

 Develop trade workflows and interfaces to set up communication between external platforms and murex to receive trade and other data feeds, process them, save into the system, and send acknowledgement. Use a combination of MXMLExchange, MXopenconnect, Murex APIs, and Datamart to successfully deliver such solutions.

 Contribute to functional documentation of the test cases and use cases by the client.

 Contribute to Design documentation for the Build process of the Product.

 Develop and maintain end-to-end configuration management packages etc. Install, Deploy and test Murex packaged interfaces like MDIT (market data interface tool), Markitwire, BSMT and MarkitCredit to receive live and end-of-day data from external providers like Bloomberg, Reuters, Markit, etc.

o Handle support cases from notification to resolution and validation.

• Participate in the business as usual and project support: follow-up of client open cases through email, CRM portal, phone-calls and on-site visits

• Develop an understanding of ongoing activities and manage own deliverables / progress

• Manage bug fixes and enhancements with the Product Team

3. Integrate with various teams to deliver the right solution to client.

o Work with S4C stream leads, Front-Office, Back-Office, or Risk teams to understand requirements and develop solutions for the client.

o Work with the Product division team to provide them timely details on defects - how to reproduce the issue, project/client constraints, and how to validate the fix.

o Follow up with the S4C stream leads, the Project Manager, and other teams to meet deadlines and regular meetings to make sure the delivery is on time.

4. Work with technologies including SQL, Unix, and Murex proprietary standards like Murex Scripting Language (MSL), XMLF, etc. for client solutions.

o Use SQL for end-of-day report generation, STP (straight through processing) failure issues, P&L evaluation, for analyzing issues in trade feed and status Etc.

o Java programming skills are not essential but are a plus.

o Various Murex proprietary languages and formats: Data Query Language for querying in various screens in MX.3, MSL (Murex Scripting Language) for pre-trade logic, XMLF for post-trade flow processing, MxML in various contexts, etc.

o Create shell/python scripts for automation of day-to-day manual activities.

Understand requirements, analyze the problem areas of the current system and behavior of pre- trade and post-trade workflow, and integration points.

Must:

- 4+ years experience with Murex Datamart and workflows

- Must know any 2 of the following technologies: MxMLExchange, RTBS/MDCS, Datamart, C2.0 Product interfaces

- SQL; XML; MxML; UNIX; Scripting languages

- Hands on experience with Murex MxML Exchange development

- Strong Knowledge of SQL/RDBMS technology

- Knowledge of XML/JSON and related technologies (XSLT), Java/J2EE, Python, or C/C++ or C#, and scripting languages such as UNIX Shell or JavaScript, Jenkins, CI/CD, DevOps, Maven, Git/Bitbucket, Apache Camel, ESB, ETL

- Must have strong personality, logical and analytical skills

- Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter

- Possess good verbal and written communication skills

- Must have strong organization skills

- Previous Experience in Murex Integration (MxML/WF) experience

- Strong Knowledge of SQL/RDBMS technology

- Familiarity with UNIX/Linux operating systems

- Strong DataMart Murex knowledge is a must

- Rigorous attention to detail

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

- Understanding of Trade life cycle

- Understanding of Market Data management

- Client focus: understands clients' businesses; identifies and understands the needs and objectives of clients, both on an individual and corporate basis; builds strong relationships to aid Luxoft's aim of being a trusted partner to the clients.

English: C2 Proficient

title: LATAM LABORATORY MANAGER
description:
Gene Solutions: Transforming Global Healthcare through Precision Medicine

Gene Solutions is a pioneering biotechnology company redefining the future of genetic testing and precision medicine. Headquartered in Singapore, the company has rapidly expanded beyond APAC into the United States and is now entering new markets across Latin America, Europe, and the Middle East.

By integrating Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) and Artificial Intelligence (AI), Gene Solutions offers a comprehensive portfolio of advanced genetic solutions that empower reproductive health, enable multi-cancer early detection, and support precision oncology.

Our Mission

As Gene Solutions expands globally, our mission remains clear: Bring World-class Genomics Closer to All.

We are committed to making genetic testing more accessible, affordable, and clinically impactful-empowering physicians and patients worldwide through innovation, collaboration, and cutting-edge science.

If you're passionate about advancing healthcare, driving innovation, and making a meaningful impact through medical AI, we invite you to join us in shaping the future of medicine.

Position Overview

We are seeking for a dynamic and results-oriented Laboratory Manager to collaborate with the expansion and growth of our business, with a primary focus on Brazil, LATAM market. This role will report to LATAM Director and is based in São Paulo.

JOB DESCRIPTION

  • Oversee the daily operations of the laboratory, ensuring efficient workflow and timely delivery of results
  • Implement and monitor quality control measures to ensure accurate test results and adherence to regulatory guidelines
  • Stay abreast of technological advancements and industry trends, evaluating and recommending new equipment and methodologies for improved laboratory efficiency
  • Design and continuously monitor detailed and complete SOPs for testing procedures
  • Provide direct training and guidance to laboratories in the Latam region
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable regulations, standards, and guidelines
  • Develop and update E-learning materials related to testing procedures
  • Prepare plans for establishing satellite laboratories and partner laboratories
  • Monitor and maintain the quality of testing at partner laboratories
  • Collaborate with other stakeholders to provide prompt and accurate laboratory results.
  • Coordinate with other departments, such as R&D, Medical, Data team to ensure seamless integration and information exchange.
  • Collaborate with bioinformatics and data analysis teams to ensure accurate and timely data analysis and interpretation.
  • Perform other tasks as assigned by the Board of Directors (BODs)

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Master's degree or higher in Biology, Biotechnology, Biomedical Science, or other related fields
  • Minimum of five years of experience in laboratory management, preferably in a medical/ NGS/ genetic/molecular testing laboratories
  • Knowledge and experience in operating Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) systems and platforms (e.g., Illumina, Thermo, Element, MGI, etc. ) for NGS or molecular biology labs
  • In-depth understanding of laboratory safety management systems , including preventive measures and best practices
  • Experience in training and developing staff in both technical and soft skills, as well as career orientation
  • Flexible in working outside of standard office hours
  • Willing to travel frequently, both domestically and internationally, as required by the job
  • Strong teamwork , presentation , and persuasion skills
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Capable of planning and being proactive at work
  • Good organizational and coordination skills
  • Fluent in English and Spanish

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor – Full-Time)

Candidates must apply with an online portfolio in order to be considered.

WHO YOU ARE

You’re a highly creative, socially fluent designer who knows how to make people stop scrolling. You understand how content performs across platforms like TikTok and Instagram and know how to turn ideas into visuals that feel native, authentic, and viral.

You’re fluent in visual storytelling — from layouts and typography to repurposing video stills or designing carousels that tell a story. You think about content as part of a bigger narrative, not just a single post. You love collaborating with others, working fast, and iterating based on feedback.

WHAT WE NEED

ODDITY is seeking a Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor) to join our Growth Marketing and Organic Social team as we launch a new brand under the ODDITY portfolio.

This role will help define how the brand looks and feels across social media — shaping everything from post design to campaign visuals and creator-led content. You’ll translate ideas into cohesive, scroll-stopping creative that drives engagement, conversation, and brand awareness. We’re looking for someone who’s deeply tuned into social trends, understands the balance of storytelling and aesthetics, and can bring a strategic eye to organic social design.

Note: Our team works EST hours, and candidates should be available during standard business hours.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design a variety of assets for organic and paid social , including carousels, post graphics, stories, and light video edits
  • Help establish the visual identity for a new ODDITY brand , ensuring consistency and cohesion across platforms
  • Partner with marketing and creative teams to interpret briefs and bring ideas to life in visually impactful ways
  • Repurpose and adapt content for different social formats and trends
  • Collaborate closely with copywriters, growth leads, and creators to build assets that feel fresh, social-first, and culturally relevant

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in graphic design for marketing or social media
  • Proficient in Figma, Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator (After Effects or Premiere a plus, but not required)
  • Strong eye for layout, typography, and visual hierarchy
  • Proven ability to design for social performance — balancing brand polish with native, engaging formats
  • Basic familiarity with AI design tools and interest in emerging creative technologies
  • Strong attention to detail and time management
  • Excellent communication skills and openness to collaboration and feedback
  • Impressive work ethic and willingness to work in a fast-paced and high-growth environment
  • Full written and spoken English proficiency

BONUS POINTS

  • Deep understanding of TikTok and Instagram aesthetics and trends
  • Experience supporting brand launches or rebrands

WHO WE ARE

ODDITY is a consumer tech company that builds and scales digital-first brands to disrupt the offline-dominated beauty and wellness industries. Using data science, AI, and tech innovation, we serve over 40 million users through personalized product experiences.

ODDITY owns IL MAKIAGE and SpoiledChild, and is now building its next breakthrough brand — launching soon.

With headquarters in New York City, an R&D center in Tel Aviv, and a biotechnology lab in Boston, ODDITY operates at the intersection of tech, science, and creativity. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and impact-driven — ideal for those who thrive on building from the ground up.

A Indigo é uma empresa multinacional que tem por propósito transformar o agronegócio através do nosso portfólio de produtos biológicos, programas de crédito de carbono e soluções de crédito agrícola.

Queremos ser o parceiro número um dos nossos clientes , cuidando de suas produções agrícolas, garantindo sustentabilidade ao meio ambiente , além de contribuir para uma alimentação mundial cada vez mais saudável.

É questionando que evoluímos.

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Contas, que será responsável por desenvolver, gerenciar e expandir relacionamentos comerciais com indústrias estratégicas no setor agrícola. Atuando com foco em produtos biológicos, o profissional irá promover soluções sustentáveis, construir valor para os clientes e garantir a implementação bem-sucedida dos produtos no campo.

Considerando suas atividades, podemos destacar:

  • Gerenciar uma carteira de clientes B2B no setor agrícola, com foco em produtos biológicos (biofungicidas, bioinseticidas, bioestimulantes, entre outros).
  • Atuar como ponto de contato estratégico entre a empresa e os clientes, assegurando comunicação eficaz, alinhamento técnico e comercial.
  • Identificar novas oportunidades de negócios e desenvolver planos para ampliar a base de clientes e o market share.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente os clientes na introdução e uso correto dos produtos, em parceria com o time de P&D.
  • Realizar apresentações técnicas e comerciais, treinamentos e dias de campo.
  • Negociar contratos, volumes e políticas comerciais de forma alinhada à estratégia da empresa.
  • Monitorar KPIs de vendas, forecast e performance de contas.
  • Alimentar o CRM com informações de mercado, concorrência e movimentações dos clientes.

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga?

  • Formação superior em Agronomia, Engenharia Agronômica, Biologia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 a 5 anos em posições de vendas ou gestão de contas B2B no setor agrícola.
  • Conhecimento técnico insumos biológicos, microbiologia agrícola, práticas sustentáveis ou agricultura regenerativa é altamente desejável.
  • Habilidades de negociação, relacionamento interpessoal e orientação a resultados.
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Excel, PowerPoint e sistemas de CRM.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Proatividade e perfil empreendedor.
  • Comunicação clara e persuasiva.
  • Visão estratégica de mercado.
  • Capacidade de lidar com objeções e ambientes técnicos.
  • Colaboração com equipes multifuncionais.

Venha fazer parte desse time que está transformando a agricultura!

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players . Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and other international markets.

We are looking for data-driven innovators who want to shape the future of iGaming and make a real impact on the industry. We value integrity, a curious mindset, empathy, and a commitment to quality. If you are eager to learn, unafraid of challenges, and ready to grow with a like-minded team — we want to hear from you.

Role

As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, and deployment of products that help companies engage with their customers in efficient and personal ways.

Our technology stack is built in Scala, NodeJS, and Ruby on Rails, running on Cassandra, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, and Kafka. We containerize and deploy with Kubernetes on AWS. You will be responsible for service delivery, reliability, scalability, monitoring, and helping define all this as immutable infrastructure-as-code.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy and maintain critical applications on cloud-native microservices architecture.
  • Implement automation, effective monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Deploy and maintain CI/CD pipelines across multiple environments.
  • Support and work alongside a cross-functional engineering team on the latest technologies.
  • Iterate on best practices to increase the quality & velocity of deployments.
  • Sustain and improve the process of knowledge sharing throughout the engineering team.

Requirements

  • Experience deploying and maintaining scalable, resilient and highly available systems in cloud environments.
  • Skills in automation of repetitive tasks (scripting via Bash, Python, Ruby).
  • Practical experience with Docker containerization and clustering (Kubernetes, ECS, Rancher).
  • Expertise with AWS (e.g., IAM, EC2, VPC, ELB, ALB, Autoscaling, Lambda).
  • Experience with version control system (e.g., Git, Gitlab).
  • Experience with configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Chef).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

Working with us implies

  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.

The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills. We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

title: Cyber Security Manager (Blockchain & Tokenization)
description:
Security Manager

Location: Americas, Remote

About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.

Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!

Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on security leader who can build, manage, and scale Pointsville’s security and compliance programs. This role is ideal for someone capable of designing enterprise-grade security programs, engineering security tools, and embedding best practices into fast-moving development environments.

What You’ll Do

Security Strategy, Leadership & Program Development

  • Build and lead Pointsville’s global security and compliance function from the ground up.
  • Develop and implement the company-wide security strategy, policies, and frameworks aligned with business and regulatory goals.
  • Conduct organization-wide risk assessments, vulnerability scans, and incident response exercises.
  • Drive security awareness and training programs to strengthen company-wide accountability.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure security goals align with organizational priorities.

Technical Security Engineering

  • Lead the design and development of advanced security testing and monitoring platforms, including distributed fuzzing systems and validation frameworks.
  • Conduct secure architecture reviews and threat modeling for infrastructure, APIs, smart contracts, and cloud-native services.
  • Integrate Secure SDLC practices into CI/CD pipelines — automating vulnerability discovery, testing, and compliance reporting.
  • Perform deep-dive analysis of vulnerabilities, exploits, and mitigations across web, mobile, and blockchain systems.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to ensure secure-by-design implementation in infrastructure-as-code and deployments.

Cloud, Infrastructure & Data Protection

  • Oversee cloud security architecture (AWS preferred), including network segmentation, IAM, and continuous monitoring.
  • Manage VPNs, multi-region access, and secret management tools (Vault, KMS, etc.).
  • Ensure data privacy and protection measures are embedded in all systems and products.
  • Lead investigations, containment, and response in the event of security incidents or data breaches.

Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Develop and maintain security compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, and CCPA.
  • Prepare and manage internal and external audits and certifications.
  • Identify, document, and mitigate enterprise security and compliance risks.
  • Establish a “privacy by design” and “security by default” culture in collaboration with legal and product teams.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Serve as the main point of contact for all internal and external security and compliance matters.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Operations to align security controls with business needs.
  • Deliver clear reporting and recommendations to leadership on security posture, incidents, and ongoing improvements.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, product security, or infrastructure security roles.
  • Proven track record designing and deploying security tools and frameworks at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cryptography, secure protocols, and key management systems.
  • Expertise in AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of application security (OWASP, STRIDE, TARA) and vulnerability mitigation.
  • Proficiency in one or more system languages (Java, C, C++, Rust, Go) and one scripting language (Python, Shell).
  • Experience with blockchain and smart contract security preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate security controls, conduct penetration testing, and perform design reviews.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with experience mentoring engineers and influencing cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in written and spoken English

We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Vendedor

  • Ambiente com forte cultura comercial, acompanhamento próximo de resultados e oportunidade de crescimento na carreira.

Why Netcore?

Being first is in our nature. Netcore Cloud is the first and leading AI/ML-powered customer engagement and experience platform (CEE) that helps B2C brands increase engagement, conversions, revenue, and retention. Our cutting-edge SaaS products enable personalized engageme1nt throughout the entire customer journey and build amazing digital experiences for businesses of all sizes.

Headquartered in Mumbai, we have global offices in 10 countries, including the United States and Germany. Being certified as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years only reinforces Netcore’s principle of being a people-centric company—where you are not just an employee but a family member.

A career at Netcore is more than just a job—it’s an opportunity to shape the future. For more information, please visit netcorecloud.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

  • Immense growth, continuous learning, and connections with top-notch brands.

  • An opportunity to explore your entrepreneurial mindset.
  • An open culture that will activate your creative spark.

title: Safety, Environment & Healthy Coordinator
description:
Somos PepsiCo

Junte-se à PepsiCo e Ouse Transformar! Somos o lugar perfeito para pessoas curiosas, pensadoras e agentes de mudança. Desde o frontline até a nossa liderança, estamos entusiasmados(as) com o futuro e trabalhamos em equipe para tornar o mundo um lugar melhor.

Fazer parte da PepsiCo significa fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de alimentos e bebidas do mundo, com nossas marcas icônicas sendo consumidas mais de um bilhão de vezes por dia em mais de 200 países. No Brasil desde 1953, a PepsiCo possui marcas reconhecidas como QUAKER®, TODDY®, TODDYNHO®, ELMA CHIPS®, RUFFLES®, DORITOS®, EQLIBRI ™, GATORADE®, KERO COCO®, H2OH!®, PEPSI® e muitas outras.

Uma carreira na PepsiCo significa trabalhar em uma cultura onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas. Aqui, você pode ousar ser você. Não importa quem você seja, de onde você venha ou quem você ame, você sempre pode influenciar as pessoas ao seu redor e causar um impacto positivo no mundo.

Conheça um pouco mais sobre a PepsiCo: PepsiCoJobs

A oportunidade

Garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro e saudável para todos os colaboradores da planta de Feira de Santana (locais administrativos, Manufatura, Warehouse e etc.), atendendo a conformidade com todas as regulamentações ambientais e de saúde e segurança relacionadas à unidade, incluindo a implementação de políticas, procedimentos e sistema de gestão interno que visam prevenir acidentes, lesões ocupacionais e impactos ambientais.

Garantir o cumprimento dos objetivos, metas e indicadores definidos pela Pepsico e definir estratégias de atuação para a área e desenvolvimento da equipe.

O seu impacto

- Garantir o cumprimento da Política de Meio Ambiente, Saúde e Segurança (SSMA) estabelecida;

- Liderar a equipe local de EHS;

- Garantir o cumprimento das normas locais, estaduais e federais de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente;

- Desenvolver e implementar programas de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente;

- Identificar e avaliar os riscos associados às operações da planta e do armazém, incluindo análises de risco de processo;

- Fornecer suporte e treinamento relacionados a EHS;

- Investigar incidentes de segurança, acidentes de trabalho e eventos ambientais para determinar as causas e implementar medidas de controle;

- Liderar a implementação e manutenção do sistema de gestão interno na fábrica;

- Gerenciar riscos e minimizar impactos relacionados às atividades, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e novas tecnologias e compartilhar as melhores práticas;

- Liderar inspeções e acompanhar visitas técnicas, inspeções e auditorias de órgãos públicos;

- Recomendar medidas de controle quanto ao grau de exposição a agentes agressivos de natureza física, química e biológica, caracterizando atividades, operações e locais insalubres e perigosos;

- Analisar e liderar a gestão de mudanças para instalações, máquinas, equipamentos e projetos da área de Engenharia;

- Especificar, controlar e supervisionar, garantindo a qualidade e a eficiência dos sistemas de proteção coletiva e Equipamentos de Segurança, incluindo equipamentos de proteção individual e equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio;

- Interagir ativamente junto aos Comitês Técnicos, principalmente liderando os programas sistêmicos visando a garantia das execuções;

- Apoiar a equipe de Engenharia durante o planejamento e execução de projetos de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente;

- Governar e gerenciar os indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) de EHS, criar planos para melhoria contínua e conformidade;

- Gerenciar o orçamento e o planejamento estratégico da área (Budget);

- Gestão do AOP (Annual Operating Plan);

- Desenvolver e apresentar os resultados de EHS à liderança e à operação;

- Implementar práticas e tecnologias sustentáveis para minimizar o impacto ambiental da operação da planta;

- Gerenciar o licenciamento da planta;

- Colaborar com outras áreas, como produção, manutenção e qualidade, para garantir a integração efetiva das práticas de EHS em todas as atividades;

- Conduzir campanhas, comunicações e programas de conscientização de EHS;

- Manter contato com agências reguladoras e acompanhar atividades de inspeção e fiscalização.

Quem estamos buscando?

  • Graduação em Engenharia com especialização em Engenharia de Segurança e Meio Ambiente;
  • Experiência sólida como líder em Meio Ambiente, Saúde e Segurança (SSMA);
  • Sólido conhecimento do sistema de gestão de SSMA;
  • Auditor líder em ISO 14001, ISO 45001 e suas aplicabilidades;
  • Sólido conhecimento das regulamentações atuais de SSMA;
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Capacidade de desenvolvimento de talentos;
  • Habilidade desenvolvida em gerenciar dados e estatísticas de SSMA;
  • Habilidades eficazes de networking em uma região multinacional, multifuncional e com múltiplas unidades de negócios;
  • Idiomas: Inglês (experiente), Espanhol (experiente) desejável.
  • Expertise em plataformas de gestão de Requisitos Legais (ex. Sistema IUS Natura);
  • Auditor líder em sistemas de gestão de EHS;

Se esta é uma oportunidade que te interessa, te encorajamos a se candidatar mesmo que não atenda a 100% dos requisitos.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:

  • Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.
  • Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico, para que você se mantenha sempre em seu melhor estado de saúde.
  • Com nosso benefício de Auto Executivo, você poderá escolher entre um carro, que inclui também ajuda com combustível e manutenção; ou um bônus de auxílio transporte (apenas para níveis gerenciais L10+).
  • Um programa de bem, com diferentes iniciativas ao longo do ano, que ajudará a promover mais equilíbri o para a sua saúde física, mental e integral -.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer (Azure Databricks) to design, implement, and optimize enterprise-grade data pipelines. In this role, you will leverage Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, SQL Server, and Python to enable scalable, governed, and performant data solutions. You will play a key role in modernizing our data platform on the Azure Cloud, ensuring reliability, efficiency, and compliance across the full data lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities:

· Data Pipeline Development: Design, build, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake) and Azure Data Factory (ADF).

· Data Flows & Transformations: Develop pipelines, data flows, and complex transformations with ADF, PySpark, and T-SQL for seamless data extraction, transformation, and loading.

· Data Processing: Develop Databricks Python notebooks for tasks such as joining, filtering, and pre-aggregation.

· Database & Query Optimization: Optimize database performance through SQL query tuning, index optimization, and code improvements to ensure efficient data retrieval and manipulation.

· SSIS & Migration Support: Maintain and enhance SSIS package design and deployment for legacy workloads; contribute to migration and modernization into cloud-native pipelines.

· Collaboration & DevOps: Work with cross-functional teams using Git (Azure Repos) for version control and Azure DevOps pipelines (CI/CD) for deployment.

· Data Governance & Security : Partner with governance teams to integrate Microsoft Purview and Unity Catalog for cataloging, lineage tracking, and role-based security.

· API & External Integration: Implement REST APIs to retrieve analytics data from diverse external data feeds, enhancing accessibility and interoperability.

· Automation: Automate ETL processes and database maintenance tasks using SQL Agent Jobs, ensuring data integrity and operational reliability.

· Advanced SQL Expertise: Craft and optimize complex T-SQL queries to support efficient data processing and analytical workloads.

Required Califications:

· 5+ years of hands-on expertise with Azure Databricks, Python, PySpark, and Delta Lake.

· 5+ years of proven experience with Azure Data Factory for orchestrating and monitoring pipelines.

· Strong SQL Server / T-SQL experience with a focus on query optimization, indexing strategies, and coding best practices.

· Demonstrated experience in SSIS package design, deployment, and performance tuning.

· Hands-on knowledge of Unity Catalog for governance.

· Experience with Git (Azure DevOps Repos) and CI/CD practices in data engineering projects.

Nice to Have:

· Exposure to Change Data Capture (CDC), Change Data Feed (CDF), and Temporal Tables.

· Experience with Microsoft Purview, Power BI, and Azure-native integrations.

· Familiarity with Profisee Master Data Management (MDM).

· Working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)

Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or equivalent advanced Azure certification

Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Professional

  • Additional Microsoft SQL Server or Azure certifications demonstrating advanced database and cloud expertise

description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A PizzattoLog é referência em transporte rodoviário e está iniciando um projeto estratégico para evoluir a programação logística e fortalecer a eficiência operacional. Buscamos Doutor(a) com perfil analítico e visão aplicada para conhecer o projeto e contribuir em um desafio real do setor, com atuação próxima da operação e foco em melhorias estruturantes. Se você quer gerar impacto direto no dia a dia da empresa e transformar conhecimento científico em solução prática, venha conhecer essa oportunidade com a PizzattoLog.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutor em Logística, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia de Transportes, Administração ou áreas afins

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Programação perfeita: atrelar carga ideal à disponibilidade de veículo em tempo real

Principais Atividades:

  • Mapear o fluxo atual de programação logística, identificando falhas e lacunas.
  • Realizar revisão bibliográfica e análise comparativa com modelos logísticos de referência.
  • Conduzir pesquisa aplicada com dados reais da empresa.
  • Construir, testar e ajustar um modelo de decisão logística baseado em critérios técnicos.
  • Implantar o modelo junto à equipe operacional e acompanhar os indicadores de desempenho.
  • Registrar os resultados e produzir documentação técnica e científica.

We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.

Requirements

  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.

Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Clinical Research Associate II (Cell Therapy)
description:
Clinical Research Associate II (Cell Therapy)

Greater Sao Paulo Area / Hybrid

Greater Rio de Janeiro Area / Hybrid

Our 3 Core Values

• Intelligence

• Integrity

• Initiative

Our mission is to harness the immune system through innovative cell therapies and other modalities to deliver widely accessible cures. Patients are waiting!

What You'll Do

The Clinical Research Associate (CRA) II will be the primary liaison between the Investigator sites and Nexcella, responsible for overall site conduct and establishing important relationships with key site personnel. The CRA will perform key job functions in accordance with ICH Good Clinical Practice (ICH GCP), FDA regulations, Nexcella SOPs and work practices while supporting the organizational mission to advance the development of promising oncology therapies and technologies to benefit patients. CRAs are expected to work in a hands-on, highly visible and autonomous role. CRAs must have the ability to be flexible and represent Nexcella in a positive and professional manner while collaborating across all levels with the clinical teams and Sponsors/vendors.

Responsibilities :

• Perform site selection, initiation, monitoring, and close-out visits of investigational sites for the Nexcella portfolio of clinical trials.

• Manage the progress of assigned sites by tracking patient recruitment and enrollment, CRF completion and submission, source data verification, data collection, and data query generation and resolution.

• Conduct monitoring activities, including, but not limited to the following:

o Ensuring PI oversight of all trial activities

o Source data review and verification with EDC fields

o Essential documentation review and reconciliation

o Investigational Product (IP) management and accountability

o Lab/kit supply management

• Develop collaborative relationships with investigative sites and personnel.

• Maintain communication with sites through frequent contact to ensure site compliance, adequate enrollment, and understanding of study requirements.

• Write and submit complete and accurate visit letters and reports of investigational site findings and update applicable CTMS.

• Escalates observed deficiencies, issues, and corrective and preventative action plans as appropriate.

• Participate in audit preparations and follow-up, as needed.

• Review and address protocol deviations, data quality issues, and identify process improvements for assigned sites.

• Be a collaborative member of the study team: provide insight, updates, and strategies to improve processes.

• Ability to think critically while prioritizing tasks in an efficient manner to meet study deliverables.

• Contribute to CRF development and perform User Access Testing, as requested.

• Assist with other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in life science/biomedical/medical science with a proficient knowledge of the clinical/scientific terminology and methods common to the oncology therapeutic setting.

• 2+ years clinical research experience is required.

• 2+ years experience at a CRO or Sponsor required.

• Independent field monitoring experience of oncology clinical trials is required.

• Early phase oncology experience is preferred.

• Proficient knowledge and practical utilization of ICH- GCP and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.

• Demonstrate effective presentation skills by clearly explaining complex concepts to a broad range of audiences.

• Ability to independently prioritize tasks with excellent time management skills.

• Highly proficient in computer applications including Microsoft suite of applications, EDC and CTMS applications.

• Fluent in English (written and verbal)

About Nexcella

Nexcella Inc., a wholly-owned Immix Biopharma subsidiary, is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company trailblazing cell therapies in AL Amyloidosis and other serious diseases. Our lead candidate is sterically-optimized BCMA-targeted chimeric antigen receptor T (CAR-T) cell therapy NXC-201.

title: Desenvolvedor RPA Pleno
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em um cliente do segmento do agronegócio , referência em inovação e transformação digital, com foco na modernização de processos, automação de fluxos e uso estratégico de tecnologia para ganho de eficiência operacional e apoio à tomada de decisão.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e implementar fluxos de automação de software , utilizando Inteligência Artificial como ferramenta de apoio ao desenvolvimento, validação e testes.
  • Criar e manter testes de automação , inclusive com suporte de ferramentas baseadas em LLMs.
  • Desenhar e evoluir fluxos de processos e jornadas do usuário , participando ativamente da análise funcional e entendimento das regras de negócio.
  • Aplicar engenharia de prompt e contexto para integrar funcionalidades baseadas em IA a sistemas já existentes.
  • Desenvolver componentes e interfaces necessárias para interação com os fluxos automatizados, com foco em usabilidade.
  • Integrar soluções com sistemas corporativos e legados (ERP, CRM e serviços internos) por meio de APIs REST .
  • Apoiar a definição de requisitos técnicos e padrões de arquitetura das soluções.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com times técnicos e áreas de negócio em ambiente ágil.

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicações e automações de software .
  • Conhecimento prático em JavaScript / TypeScript .
  • Vivência com NodeJS para integração e suporte às automações.
  • Experiência no consumo e desenvolvimento de APIs REST .
  • Experiência em análise funcional , entendimento de processos e desenho de fluxos.
  • Conhecimento aplicado em engenharia de prompt para LLMs .
  • Experiência com testes automatizados .
  • Atuação em ambientes ágeis (Scrum / Kanban).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código ( Git ).

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência com automação de processos digitais (fora do contexto de RPA tradicional).
  • Vivência em testes e validações apoiadas por ferramentas de IA.
  • Experiência em projetos que envolvam regras de negócio complexas
  • Capacidade de utilizar IA como copiloto de desenvolvimento , mantendo senso crítico e qualidade técnica.
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para colaborar com áreas técnicas e de negócio.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

title: Gerente administrativo e financeiro
description:
Summary

We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to partner with the Managing Director and the market team to deliver the business plan and support operational execution. This is a managerial role focused on leadership, planning and process improvement, with occasional hands-on operational tasks.

Key responsibilities

Financial and operational leadership

• Act as a trusted business partner to the Managing Director and the wider market team to deliver budget and strategy.

• Own the annual budget, periodic reforecasts and the monthly forward-looking risks & opportunities view, and drive commercial action plans where required.

• Break the business plan and budget into measurable building blocks and KPIs, ensure they are tracked by the FP&A team and by functional partners, and lead corrective actions when performance deviates from target.

• Track return on key investments, including capex for new sales initiatives, and provide actionable analysis to improve outcomes.

• Provide occasional hands-on operational support at month-end to ensure accurate and timely close (see operational tasks below).

Hands-on operational support

• Perform or assist with select month-end journal entries and accruals to support timely close.

• Reconcile key balance sheet accounts and resolve reconciling items when needed.

• Support billing or cash collection tasks in peak periods to ensure targets are met.

• Coordinate with shared services or external teams to clear blockers that would delay reporting.

Finance team leadership

• Build and develop a high-performing finance function aligned to company strategy.

• Line-manage and mentor key direct reports (for example Financial Control, FP&A, Billing and Cash Collection), ensuring the right people are in the right roles.

• Lead recruitment and onboarding of new finance talent as the business grows to support delivery of the plan.

• Foster collaboration between finance and commercial teams to embed financial discipline across the market.

Process leadership

• Provide market leadership on ERP implementation and realise business benefits from new systems.

• Identify and prioritise process improvements across the business (for example debtor management) and drive execution to close the gaps.

• Work with the Group finance community to implement best practices and share learnings that other markets can adopt.

Reporting and compliance

• Ensure accurate and timely monthly and annual reporting that meets Group and third-party obligations and that tracks progress against business goals and KPIs.

• Plan and oversee the annual audit and tax filings, working with the Group tax and control teams to optimise outcomes.

• Support wider reporting requirements such as CSRD and other regulatory or sustainability disclosures as required.

Liquidity and cash management

• Drive delivery against cash targets, ensuring profit is converted into cash.

• Assign ownership and targets for each element of working capital, and drive process improvements where necessary.

• Maintain a 13-week cash flow forecast and a budgeted liquidity plan.

• Coordinate with Group to repatriate cash to the parent company in line with the plan.

Project leadership

• Lead ad-hoc strategic projects, including business cases for commercial opportunities and support for acquisitions or integrations as they arise.

• Provide commercial and financial analysis to support decision making and monitor project outcomes.

Desired experience and skills

• Proven finance manager experience in a commercial environment, ideally with exposure to FP&A, financial control and cash management.

• Strong analytical skills and experience converting financial insight into commercial action.

• Experience leading finance teams and developing talent.

• Comfortable working with ERP systems and driving process improvements.

• Hands-on month-end close experience and a pragmatic approach to resolving operational issues.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Head of Operations (Physical Expansion & Product Lineup)

São Paulo (base) | Frequent travel across Brazil

PJ | Full-time

About Pagô

Pagô is evolving.

We are moving beyond a purely digital model to build a field-driven financial operation , with physical points of presence embedded in the real Brazilian economy.

These locations will not only operate Pagô’s core products — they will also serve as distribution hubs for a broader financial product lineup , built in partnership with external providers.

This role exists because physical execution, product mix, and partnerships must be built together .

The Role

We are looking for a COO with a CEO mindset to design, build, and run Pagô’s physical operations , end to end.

This includes:

  • Building the physical operation
  • Defining what products are offered in each location
  • Structuring and managing relationships with financial product providers

You will take Pagô from strategy to the ground — location by location.

This is a builder role , not a maintenance role.

What You Will Build

  • Pagô’s physical operational model
  • A scalable store-level product lineup (payments, credit, and partner products)
  • Strategic relationships with financial product providers
  • On-the-ground presence in selected cities (especially in the Brazilian interior)
  • Teams, routines, and processes that function in real environments
  • A repeatable playbook for physical expansion

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement Pagô’s physical operations strategy
  • Identify, evaluate, and support the selection of new operational locations
  • Lead the setup of physical points of presence (from zero to running)
  • Define the product lineup offered in each physical location , aligned with local demand
  • Build and manage relationships with financial product providers and partners
  • Negotiate commercial terms, distribution models, and operational flows with providers
  • Ensure products are properly integrated into day-to-day operations
  • Hire, train, and manage local teams
  • Define operational processes that work in the field
  • Be present where the operation happens: customers, partners, local ecosystems
  • Ensure operational consistency while scaling across locations
  • Act as the main execution leader for physical expansion
  • Work closely with product, credit, and risk teams
  • Report directly to the founder with high autonomy

Who We’re Looking For

This role is for top-tier operators with commercial and product judgment .

You are someone who:

  • Thrives in building operations from scratch
  • Understands how product, distribution, and operations connect
  • Is energized by being in the field, not behind a desk
  • Has strong execution discipline and commercial instincts
  • Is highly organized and ownership-driven
  • Is comfortable making decisions with incomplete information
  • Has full flexibility for travel and on-site work
  • Leads by presence and example

Experience with financial products (payments, credit, banking, fintech, or regulated financial operations) and/or building distribution partnerships is a strong plus .

Non-Negotiables

  • High mobility and availability for field work
  • Hands-on leadership style
  • Comfort with ambiguity and responsibility
  • Strong bias toward execution over discussion

What This Is Not

  • Not a corporate COO role
  • Not a strategy-only position
  • Not a remote or desk-only job
  • Not a role for people who avoid operational friction

Compensation

  • Fixed compensation (PJ)
  • Performance-based bonus tied to:
  • Store rollout
  • Product lineup execution
  • Provider partnerships
  • Operational performance
  • Long-term upside aligned with impact

Why This Role Matters

Pagô believes that real financial infrastructure is built on the ground , close to businesses and their ecosystems.

This role sits at the intersection of:

operations × product × distribution .

If you want to build physical operations, define what gets sold, and decide how financial products reach the field , this role was designed for you.

Interested? Send a DM or apply directly.

Rodou, girou, Pagô. ⚡

title: Oracle Cloud Field Service consultant

Job Specification: Oracle Cloud Field Service Consultant

Contract Role – Remote

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud Field Service (OFS) Consultant to support the design, configuration, optimization, and ongoing enhancement of our field service operations. This is a remote contract role suited for someone with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Field Service Cloud, with additional experience in Oracle Service Cloud (OSvC) and Oracle CPQ being highly desirable.

  • Lead the implementation, configuration, and customization of Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) to support business workflows, scheduling, routing, and mobile field operations.

  • Perform solution testing, UAT support, documentation, and knowledge transfer to internal teams.

  • Support deployment activities, including data migration, configuration promotion, and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including service operations, IT, product management, and vendors.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) .
  • Strong understanding of OFS architecture, configuration frameworks, APIs, message scenarios, routing, and capacity planning.
  • Experience designing workflows, activity types, and policy configurations in OFS.
  • Ability to write and interpret OFS API integrations, business rules, and extensibility scripts.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements and convert them into actionable configuration.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery environments.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

Desired Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with Oracle Service Cloud (RightNow/OSvC) configuration, workflows, and integrations.

  • Understanding of broader Oracle CX Cloud architecture and integrations.
  • Experience with mobile workforce or field service applications outside Oracle.
  • Knowledge of cloud integration tools (OIC, Boomi, MuleSoft, etc.).

title: Product Designer
description:
About the Company

Hi, we’re Actabl. We’re providing better solutions for hotel companies as the world around us evolves and changes related to using technology, finding labor, and maximizing profits. Our mission is to empower the people that power hospitality. We give hoteliers actionable insights to know what to do, the tools to do it, and the visibility to know it worked. We bring together powerful hospitality tech solutions to maximize profits for more than 10,000 properties in hospitality markets around the world.

Our Valued Behaviors

  • Start with People: We are in the hospitality business and hospitality starts with people. This impacts both our being and our doing.
  • Being: We are responsible for building relationships, earning trust, and having fun. These things are fundamental to hospitality.
  • Doing: We will succeed if we start with great people working as one team. Empower others, speak the truth with care, and go together.
  • Demand Integrity: Be trustworthy, be ethical, and be consistent whether someone is watching or not. Demand integrity of yourself and others to build the fabric of a high-integrity organization.
  • Delight the Customer: We aim to delight our customers in the same way our customers aim to delight their guests. The question is not if completed a process or hit a metric, the question is whether or not the customer is delighted.
  • Champion Innovation: We compete in the game of change and win through innovation. Think big and then think bigger when it comes to the innovation required to tackle the problems our customers face daily.
  • Make it Happen: We show up prepared, care about the details, and follow through. Don't get distracted. Don't stop at blockers. Don't make excuses. Find a way and drive until it is done.

About Actabl's Product Design Team

We redefine expectations

We treat SaaS with the same passion and craft you’d expect from world-class consumer products. Our mission is to redefine what hospitality teams can expect from their tools by delivering thoughtful, high-quality experiences and pushing the product forward step by step, with real impact.

Bellhop Design System

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
We are looking for a high-performing Full Stack Engineer with strong experience in both Python (backend) and React (frontend) to join our client’s distributed engineering team in Brazil. This role is ideal for someone who excels at building clean, scalable APIs and intuitive user interfaces while collaborating with product, design, and engineering stakeholders.

You will be responsible for developing end-to-end features, improving system architecture, and supporting the evolution of a modern tech stack powering mission-critical applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Python (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • Develop responsive, user-friendly front-end applications using React, Typescript, and modern UI frameworks.
  • Implement RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs and integrate them with internal and external systems.
  • Work closely with product managers and UX/UI designers to translate requirements into high-quality code.
  • Optimize performance across front-end and back-end components.
  • Manage databases and data models (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, etc.).
  • Contribute to overall system architecture, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
  • Write automated tests (unit, integration, end-to-end) to maintain code quality.
  • Collaborate in an agile environment with remote teams across Brazil.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–7+ years of experience as a Full Stack Engineer or Software Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python and popular backend frameworks (FastAPI preferred, Flask, Django).
  • Professional experience with React and Typescript (Hooks, Context, Redux, or similar).
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs or GraphQL services.
  • Strong understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases.
  • Experience deploying applications using cloud services ( AWS, GCP, or Azure ).
  • Solid grasp of software architecture, design patterns, and version control (Git).
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment with clear communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized deployments.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI).
  • Exposure to microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with testing frameworks (PyTest, Jest, Cypress, etc.).
  • Experience working with Brazilian or international distributed engineering teams.

title: Data Research Analyst
description:
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 3-5 years of data analysis and reporting experience
  • Advanced experience writing and creating large-scale surveys (QuestionPro, Qualtrics), analyzing results/data, and developing actionable findings
  • Experience with Tableau for data visualization
  • Experience in writing detailed reports and presenting data findings/analysis.

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Passion for video games/gaming in order to assist in writing and interpreting survey questions
  • Experience with SQL writing data queries
  • Snowflake or Data Bricks experience

Insight Global is hiring a Data Research Analyst to support the User Experience Research team at a leading company in the Gaming industry. The main role of the Data Research Analyst will be to create, send, and analyze large-scale surveys intended to learn about the player base of the core gaming products.

Job Functions

-Create surveys and trackers to support all products and initiatives

  • Design questions that do not bias respondents
  • Use best practice methodologies to produce actionable, accurate, and representative data.

-Advanced, survey focused, data visualizations (Tableau, Excel, Sheets)

  • Creating clear reports and dashboards based on surveys sent to players and users of their products.

-Data queries (HIVE, Snowflake, Tableau)

  • Querying multiple types of databases and plugging data queries directly into tools like Tableau are essential for this role. These skills will be used to target audiences for survey sends, pull in additional analytics to identify respondents, and allow for advanced data visualizations.

-Report writing and presenting data

  • Writing detailed and understandable reports that will speak to a variety of audiences across the enterprise
  • Presenting data in meetings and providing additional relevant context where applicable.

-Act as backup for all functions of current data researchers

-Provide support to UX researchers on report creation that involves data visualization.

-Quickly pivot with new data to ensure a constant flow of player insights are output as updated player survey data is received to ensure we are always reporting on timely and relevant findings.

-Contribute to overall needs of the UXR team e.g. peer review, supporting other teams with survey expertise, etc.

-Contribute survey expertise to assist others in the company with the creation of surveys.

title: Coordenador fiscal - Torre de faturamento
description:
Briefing da posição:

Como Coordenador/Supervisor Fiscal da Torre de Faturamento, o profissional será responsável por liderar a operação fiscal vinculada ao faturamento da empresa (“torre” de faturamento), assegurando o correto processamento de notas fiscais, apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos, cumprimento de obrigações acessórias, e a entrega de resultados por meio de KPIs.

Espera-se perfil de liderança, domínio técnico e capacidade de interface executiva (internamente com Financeiro, Faturamento, Contabilidade, Comercial, e externamente com clientes). O inglês avançado será requisito para interação com equipes globais ou clientes internacionais.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Coordenar as atividades da torre de faturamento: emissão e conferência de notas fiscais (saídas/entradas), conferência de faturamento, retenções, XML, NFS-e/NF-e, CTe, etc.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de obrigações acessórias: SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, DCTF, EFD-Contribuições, REINF, ECF/ECD, etc;
  • Implantar e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) da operação fiscal/faturamento (por exemplo: % de notas com erro fiscal, tempo de processamento, custo por nota, índice de credits fiscais aproveitados, SLA de faturamento, conformidade) e reportar à liderança executiva;
  • Desenvolver e liderar a equipe da torre (coordenados e analistas), promovendo treinamento, engajamento, definição de metas, monitoramento de performance e melhorias contínuas de processo;
  • Interface com Financeiro, Contabilidade, Comercial/Vendas, TI/ERP e auditoria, assegurando que as operações de faturamento estejam alinhadas aos controles internos, aos requisitos de compliance e às estratégias de negócio;
  • Liderar ou participar de iniciativas de melhoria de processos, automação, mapeamento de riscos fiscais, aproveitamento de créditos, e adaptação a mudanças da legislação (como reforma tributária, por exemplo) ou cenários de negócio;
  • Apresentar análises gerenciais e relatórios executivos (em inglês, quando for o caso) à alta direção ou matriz, com propostas de ação, acompanhamento de metas e suportes decisórios.

Qualificações & requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Preferencialmente com registro CRC ativo (quando aplicável);
  • Experiência sólida em operação fiscal/tributária, com apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos em ambiente corporativo;
  • Experiência comprovada em faturamento ou faturamento tributário (emissão de notas fiscais, retenções, faturamento em operação com produtos/serviços) e liderança de equipe;
  • Inglês avançado (oral e escrito) – para reportes, interface com clientes estrangeiros;
  • Perfil forte de liderança, com habilidades executivas — comunicação clara, capacidade de influenciar, visibilidade junto à diretoria, visão de negócio;
  • Familiaridade com KPIs, dashboards, relatórios gerenciais, e métricas de performance da área fiscal/faturamento;
  • Atuação em ambiente de alta demanda, com foco em prazos, entregas, auditorias e mudanças regulatórias;

Competências comportamentais:

  • Visão estratégica com mindset operacional (“hands-on”);
  • Alta capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes;
  • Orientação para resultados e melhoria contínua;
  • Excelente comunicação (com a equipe, stakeholders e diretoria);
  • Adaptabilidade e proatividade para lidar com mudanças rápidas (ex: reforma tributária, nova legislação);
  • Integridade, postura ética e foco em compliance;

title: Analista de Suporte à Gestão Ágil (SAFe / ARTs)
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.

Sobre a vaga:

Você tem familiaridade com SAFe , gosta de ambientes ágeis complexos e quer apoiar grandes times a entregarem valor de forma estruturada e eficiente? Essa vaga pode ser sua!

O que você vai fazer:

  • Suportar o Release Train Engineer (RTE) na gestão e otimização do fluxo de entrega de valor de um Agile Release Train (ART) ;
  • Apoiar a execução dos Program Increments (PI), participando da preparação, realização e retrospectiva de eventos como PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums, PO Syncs, System Demos, Inspect & Adapt ;
  • Elaborar artefatos, atas, relatórios e análises com base em dados extraídos de ferramentas de gestão ágil (burnup, burndown, OKRs, throughput, etc);
  • Apoiar na resolução de impedimentos e no acompanhamento de riscos e dependências;
  • Atuar no acompanhamento financeiro de épicos/features e alimentar sistemas integrados de gestão;
  • Suportar auditorias e controles (como SOX), mantendo a conformidade dos dados operacionais e financeiros;
  • Colaborar com levantamentos de maturidade ágil, DevOps , e apoiar planos de ação de melhoria contínua.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência com suporte à gestão em ambientes ágeis estruturados (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe);
  • Conhecimento no framework SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) – desejável certificação ;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão ágil e análise de dados operacionais (Jira, Excel avançado, etc);

title: DevOps Sênior
description:
A Privacy é a maior rede social de conteúdo digital da América Latina. Nascemos para conectar tecnologia ao poder criativo das pessoas. Somos um organismo vivo, onde cada pessoa é uma célula pulsante de abundância, liberdade e autorrealização.

Aqui, performance tem propósito, estrutura tem calor humano e ambição anda junto com ética.

Nosso produto é uma rede social líder em monetização de conteúdo no Brasil, em plena expansão internacional. Esse crescimento exige um(a) Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) com mentalidade de engenharia, foco em automação, observabilidade e resiliência — capaz de operar e evoluir ambientes críticos, distribuídos e de larga escala.

Responsabilidades

Administração, Observabilidade e Operação

  • Projetar e operar ambientes altamente disponíveis, escaláveis e resilientes em AWS e Azure .
  • Construir e manter SLOs, SLIs e SLAs , garantindo confiabilidade alinhada ao negócio.
  • Implementar práticas completas de observabilidade (métricas, logs, tracing, dashboards, alertas).
  • Monitorar, diagnosticar e corrigir incidentes em tempo real.
  • Participar ativamente de on-call , garantindo resposta rápida e eficaz a incidentes críticos.

Automação, Infraestrutura e Deploy

  • Criar automações de provisioning, deploy, monitoramento e testes (Python, Go, Bash ou Node.js).
  • Desenvolver pipelines de CI/CD com rollback seguro e validações robustas.
  • Operar e gerenciar containers em Docker, Kubernetes, ECS, EKS e AKS .
  • Implementar infraestrutura como código com Terraform , CloudFormation ou Pulumi.

Arquitetura, Resiliência e Segurança

  • Realizar tuning básico em bancos SQL e NoSQL, garantindo confiabilidade e desempenho.
  • Configurar redes: DNS, rotas, firewalls, VPC, load balancing e componentes essenciais.
  • Aplicar políticas de segurança (IAM, RBAC, hardening e conformidade).
  • Conduzir testes de caos, cenários de falha, DR e resiliência.
  • Criar ferramentas internas que aumentem eficiência e reduzam débito operacional.

O que valorizamos

Mentalidade de engenharia e automação: eliminação de tarefas manuais e criação de soluções escaláveis.

Capacidade analítica e orientação a dados: decisões guiadas por evidências.

Colaboração multidisciplinar: integração com Engenharia, Segurança, Arquitetura e Produto.

Clareza na comunicação: essencial em ambientes críticos.

Autonomia, resiliência e priorização: atuação madura em cenários de pressão e alta complexidade.

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida operando ambientes críticos e de alta disponibilidade.
  • Domínio em AWS e Azure .
  • Experiência com Infra as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi).
  • Containers e orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes, ECS, EKS, AKS .
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
  • Observabilidade: Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace .
  • Conhecimento em redes (DNS, TCP/IP, VPC, firewalls, protocolos).
  • Noções sólidas de bancos relacionais e NoSQL.
  • Scripts e automações (Python, Go, Bash ou Node.js).
  • Vivência com incidentes, RCA estruturado e práticas modernas de SRE.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes de missão crítica (fintech, pagamentos, e-commerce, telecom).
  • Conhecimento em Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS ou SNS.
  • Práticas avançadas de Zero Trust e segurança em nuvem.
  • Vivência com arquiteturas distribuídas e event-driven.
  • Certificações relevantes (AWS, DevOps, Kubernetes, Azure).
  • Participação em programas estruturados de on-call.
  • Contribuição para a comunidade (open source, artigos, palestras).

Modelo de contratação e ambiente

  • Contratação: PJ
  • Local: Presencial — Zona Sul de São Paulo/SP
  • Ambiente colaborativo, com cultura forte, liberdade técnica e foco em inovação.
  • Estrutura horizontal, com autonomia para propor, testar e evoluir soluções.

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico (para CNPJs ativos há pelo menos 6 meses) ;
  • Cartão Caju;
  • TotalPass;
  • Estacionamento conveniado;
  • Ambiente dinâmico, com alto nível técnico, aprendizado contínuo e impacto direto no negócio.

Por que entrar na Privacy

Estamos evoluindo e ampliando nossa infraestrutura para suportar o crescimento acelerado da plataforma.

Como SRE, você terá impacto direto na confiabilidade, segurança, escala e eficiência dos sistemas que atendem milhões de usuários.

Se você busca um ambiente técnico desafiador, com autonomia e cultura de engenharia madura, essa é a oportunidade ideal.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Administração, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia como Generalista de RH ou posições correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em processos de performance, sucessão, remuneração, desenvolvimento e engajamento.

  • Inglês intermediário
